extra.message: completeAccountVerification (POST /api/auth/verification/complete, mounted before requireAuth) looks the account up by email only and never validates the client-supplied 'token' against the stored resetTokenHash, nor checks that a verification was even requested. An attacker can inject arbitrary SQL (e.g. keyword=`' OR '1'='1' UNION SELECT ...`), allowing full read/write of the Postgres database.
